title: Total Chaos
author: Ty_
rules:
Chaos Construction

Each row, column, and region must contain the digits 1-9 once each. Regions must be deduced by the solver. Regions are orthogonally contiguous.

Chaotic X-Sums

Clues outside the grid indicate the sum of the first X digits from that direction, where X is the first digit seen. Those X first digits all belong to the same region. The next digit after that belongs to a different region.

Maximum

Marked cells are greater than all orthogonal neighbours.
